description.narrative: (Yemen): With FY 2024 funds, the Peace and Inclusive Political Processes in Yemen Program will partner with the Republic of Yemen Government (ROYG) and allies to support its efforts to govern more effectively and responsively and to function as a more productive interlocutor in peace and political processes. The program will also strengthen the capacity of Yemeni civil society, with a particular focus on youth and the private sector, to partake in consensus-building efforts and to meaningfully participate in the public life of Yemen. Finally, the Program will support the safe and meaningful participation of women in both the ROYG and civil society organizations (CSOs) in governance, peace, and political processes, including in leadership positions. .Key interventions will include advancing results-driven dialogue among government and civil society; fostering consensus-based dialogue among political actors; providing training and capacity building opportunities to enhance government effectiveness, oversight, and accountability; fostering networking, relationship-building, and advocacy across different groups; and supporting gender-sensitive policy development. As a whole, these interventions strengthen governance and advance a more inclusive and durable peace process in Yemen. ..
